raw_need: Keep QIF ahead of current AI development trends and release the nearest roadmap target
validated_need: Complete v0.4.3 core verifier fixture coverage now, while updating the future roadmap toward outcome-grounded, long-horizon, multi-agent quality governance
decision_summary: The nearest accepted release target is v0.4.3. New agentic features are deferred until the core verifier claims are regression-proven; the roadmap is updated now so later slices address current and next-wave agent quality risks in order.

validation_questions_answered.question: Which environment and scope?
validation_questions_answered.answer: Official AI Org Labs QIF repository; v0.4.3 core fixture coverage, roadmap, AOF evidence, and release only

validation_questions_answered.question: What is success?
validation_questions_answered.answer: Complete rule-to-negative-fixture coverage, green tests and AOF verification, and exact-SHA v0.4.3 publication

hidden_assumptions: Adding new AI-facing entities before closing verifier regression coverage would lead the trend more effectively
evidence_gaps: Empirical calibration and real multi-agent outcome data remain future pilot evidence, not v0.4.3 claims
